calls.video_title: 5 BEST STocks to BUY in November
calls.price_at_call: Down ~10% in the past week; still down 20% over 5 years
calls.thesis: BUY, first explicit Roussin BA call (prior note was UNCERTAIN watchlist only): a long-term cash-flow turnaround buy, explicitly not a next-month growth trade; owns it.
calls.base_case: Record order backlog at levels never seen, production ramping, and FCF turning positive through 2024-26 after the MAX grounding and pandemic years.
calls.bull_case: If Boeing converts the backlog efficiently, cash generation follows.
calls.bear_case: Execution, regulatory and financial-obligation risks; the path to stronger cash generation may take longer than investors expected.
